name: What is rental property cash flow and why is it important to calculate?

mainEntity.name: What is rental property cash flow and why is it important to calculate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rental property cash flow is the net income generated by a rental property after all operating expenses, including mortgage payments, have been paid. It represents the money left over each month that you can use or reinvest. Calculating cash flow is crucial because it indicates a property's financial health and profitability, helping investors determine if an investment is worthwhile and sustainable. For prospective investors in areas like Miami-Dade or Broward County, understanding this metric early helps in identifying properties that align with their financial goals, preventing negative cash flow situations that can drain resources.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rental property cash flow is the net income after all expenses. Calculating it is essential to determine a property's financial health and profitability before investing.
